geometry_source: KITTI-360 raw Velodyne sweeps + cam0_to_world.txt + calibration (P_rect_00, R_rect_00, calib_cam_to_velo)

correspondence_rule.landmarks: raw Velodyne returns of the sweep at A, velo->unrectified cam0->world (GT poses), rect_cam_to_velo = cam0_to_velo @ inv(R_rect_00)
correspondence_rule.projection: K = P_rect_00[:3,:3] on the native 1408x376 image; cam0_to_world.txt poses; depth in (3, 50) m; 12-px border
correspondence_rule.visibility: min sweep depth of the same frame in a 7x7 px window; |z - ref| < a + b z, strict (0.3, 0.01), loose (0.6, 0.02); no return -> rejected

controls.C0: landmark of an earlier unrelated (A,B) set of the drive (reservoir of 4000)
controls.C3: different landmark whose per-view class in B equals X's class in A

feature.source: feature-first token cache (Trident-H correlation-refined CLIP ViT-H-14 tokens, 1024-d, unit norm, 34x128)
feature.sampling: bilinear at native pixel centres, align_corners=False (== official logit interpolation)
feature.classification: softmax(40 f . text) with Trident's own text embeddings

mapper_replay.inputs: stream cache pred_depth / pred_pose_c2w / pred_K, scale = exp(median(log_s[:5]))
mapper_replay.association: LingBot endpoint band (-1,0,+1 voxel) into 0.2 m world voxels; X placed via GT camera-frame coordinates at A and LingBot pose of A

env.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Max-Q Workstation Edition
